fusion: unweighted arithmetic mean of existing normal-calibrated channel scores
partial_auc: integral of ROC over FPR [0,0.1], divided by 0.1; random=0.05
bootstrap_unit: video, paired within each task; independent task draws; equal-task mean
gate_interpretation: Development resource gate only; failure is insufficient support for expansion, not proof of no information. Old G1 remains failed.
fixed_roi: reuse frozen source/detect.py, original thresholds and same 3 frames, EVA02 features, pool_vector and density
centroid_diagnostic: four raw attention centroids, standardize on normal train, LedoitWolf per step, leave-one-video distances, no unit normalization or PCA
normal_threshold: 90th percentile (higher) on existing normal validation; threshold fixed before test evaluation
caution: Both tasks have been explored. Conditional bootstrap excludes training-seed and normal-reference uncertainty. Validation was also used for checkpoint selection. Calibration is empirical.
